      description: Candidate contact profile with base candidate fields plus aggregated phones/emails and latest resume/LinkedIn/GitHub URLs
      grain: One row per candidate_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__phone_number
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__email_address
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__social_media_address
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__attachment
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate; return one row per candidate_id with all base candidate fields. - Phones: for each candidate, build values as "phone_type: phone_number" only when both parts are present; join values with ", "; keep duplicates; preserve original text; order is not specified; if none, set NULL. - Emails: for each candidate, wrap each non-null email_address in angle brackets like "<email_address>"; join with ", "; keep duplicates; preserve original text; order is not specified; if none, set NULL. - Latest resume: from attachments where type equals "resume" ignoring case, choose the row with the highest index per candidate; if multiple share the highest index, pick any; output its url as resume_url; if none, set NULL. - Latest LinkedIn: from social media URLs containing "linkedin" ignoring case, choose the row with the highest social_media_index per candidate; if tied, pick any; output its social_media_url as linkedin_url; if none, set NULL. - Latest GitHub: from social media URLs containing "github" ignoring case, choose the row with the highest social_media_index per candidate; if tied, pick any; output its social_media_url as github_url; if none, set NULL. - Left join all aggregates to the base by candidate_id; unmatched aggregates remain NULL. No final ordering is applied.'

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique candidate identifier from stg_greenhouse__candidate; one output row per candidate_id

      description: Aggregates candidate tags into a single string, counts tag associations, and flags presence of technical or experience tags.
      grain: One row per candidate_id with at least one joined tag association
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate_tag
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__candidate
      - staging.stg_greenhouse__tag
      business_logic: '- Start from candidate-tag associations and inner join to candidate on candidate_id and to tag on tag_id. - Group by candidate_id and full_name. - tags: concatenate all non-null tag names separated by ", "; duplicates are kept; original casing and spacing are preserved; ordering is unspecified; if no non-null tag names exist in the group, the result is NULL. - tag_count: total number of joined tag associations per candidate, including rows where the tag name is NULL. - has_technical_tag: TRUE if any tag name contains "technical" when compared case-insensitively; otherwise FALSE. - has_experience_tag: TRUE if any tag name contains "experience" when compared case-insensitively; otherwise FALSE. - Due to inner joins, only candidates present in all three sources with at least one matching tag are included.'
      columns:
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Candidate identifier; one output row per candidate_id present after the inner joins.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name from the candidate source paired with candidate_id; may be NULL.
      - name: tags
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenated tag names separated by ', '; duplicates kept; NULL tag names skipped; ordering unspecified; NULL if no non-null tag names.
      - name: tag_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total tag associations per candidate after joins, including rows where the tag name is NULL.
      - name: has_technical_tag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any tag name includes 'technical' ignoring case; otherwise FALSE; never NULL.
      - name: has_experience_tag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any tag name includes 'experience' ignoring case; otherwise FALSE; never NULL.

WITH hiring_teams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT job_id, hiring_managers, recruiters, sourcers
    FROM intermediate.int_greenhouse__hiring_team
),
application_stats AS (
    SELECT job_id,
        COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS count_total_applications,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active')::BIGINT AS count_active_applications,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'hired')::BIGINT AS count_hired_applications,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected')::BIGINT AS count_rejected_applications,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prospect::VARCHAR = 'True')::BIGINT AS count_prospect_applications
    FROM intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_info
    WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY job_id
),
interview_stats AS (
    SELECT app.job_id,
        COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS count_total_interviews,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE interview.status = 'completed')::BIGINT AS count_completed_interviews,
        COUNT(DISTINCT app.application_id) AS application_count,
        AVG(CASE sc.overall_recommendation WHEN 'definitely_not' THEN 1 WHEN 'no' THEN 2 WHEN 'yes' THEN 3 WHEN 'strong_yes' THEN 4 END) AS avg_job_rating,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sc.overall_recommendation IS NOT NULL)::BIGINT AS count_rated_applications
    FROM intermediate.int_greenhouse__application_info AS app
    INNER JOIN intermediate.int_greenhouse__interview_scorecard AS interview ON app.application_id = interview.application_id
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__scorecard AS sc ON interview.scorecard_id = sc.scorecard_id
    GROUP BY app.job_id
),
job_metrics AS (
    SELECT j.*, ht.hiring_managers, ht.recruiters, ht.sourcers,
        COALESCE(a.count_total_applications, 0)::BIGINT AS count_total_applications,
        COALESCE(a.count_active_applications, 0)::BIGINT AS count_active_applications,
        COALESCE(a.count_hired_applications, 0)::BIGINT AS count_hired_applications,
        COALESCE(a.count_rejected_applications, 0)::BIGINT AS count_rejected_applications,
        COALESCE(a.count_prospect_applications, 0)::BIGINT AS count_prospect_applications,
        COALESCE(i.count_total_interviews, 0)::BIGINT AS count_total_interviews,
        COALESCE(i.count_completed_interviews, 0)::BIGINT AS count_completed_interviews,
        i.application_count, i.avg_job_rating,
        COALESCE(i.count_rated_applications, 0)::BIGINT AS count_rated_applications,
        CASE WHEN i.count_total_interviews > 0 THEN 1.0::DECIMAL(2,1) END AS rating_completion_rate
    FROM intermediate.int_greenhouse__job_info AS j
    LEFT JOIN hiring_teams AS ht ON j.job_id = ht.job_id
    LEFT JOIN application_stats AS a ON j.job_id = a.job_id
    LEFT JOIN interview_stats AS i ON j.job_id = i.job_id
)
SELECT job_id, name, status, requisition_id, created_at, departments, offices,
    hiring_managers, recruiters, sourcers,
    count_total_applications, count_active_applications, count_hired_applications, count_rejected_applications, count_prospect_applications,
    count_total_interviews, count_completed_interviews,
    count_total_interviews::DOUBLE / NULLIF(application_count, 0) AS avg_interviews_per_application,
    avg_job_rating, count_rated_applications, rating_completion_rate,
    CASE WHEN count_total_applications > 0 THEN count_total_interviews * 100.0 / count_total_applications ELSE 0.0 END AS application_to_interview_rate,
    CASE WHEN count_total_interviews > 0 THEN count_hired_applications * 100.0 / count_total_interviews ELSE 0.0 END AS interview_to_hire_rate,
    CASE WHEN count_total_applications > 0 THEN count_hired_applications * 100.0 / count_total_applications ELSE 0.0 END AS overall_conversion_rate,
    YEAR(created_at)::BIGINT AS created_year, MONTH(created_at)::BIGINT AS created_month,
    DATE_DIFF('microsecond', created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) / 86400000000.0 AS days_since_created
FROM job_metrics

WITH job_applications AS (
    SELECT j.job_id, j.name AS job_title, j.status AS job_status, j.created_at AS job_created_at,
        YEAR(a.applied_at)::BIGINT AS application_year, QUARTER(a.applied_at)::BIGINT AS application_quarter,
        COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS total_applications,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.candidate_id)::BIGINT AS unique_candidates,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'hired')::BIGINT AS hired_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'active')::BIGINT AS active_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.rejected_at IS NOT NULL)::BIGINT AS rejected_count,
        AVG(DATE_DIFF('microsecond', a.applied_at, COALESCE(a.rejected_at, a.last_activity_at)) / 86400000000.0) AS avg_process_days
    FROM staging.stg_greenhouse__job AS j
    INNER JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__job_application AS ja ON j.job_id = ja.job_id
    INNER JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__application AS a ON ja.application_id = a.application_id
    WHERE a.applied_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY j.job_id, j.name, j.status, j.created_at, application_year, application_quarter
),
interview_metrics AS (
    SELECT ja.job_id, YEAR(a.applied_at)::BIGINT AS application_year, QUARTER(a.applied_at)::BIGINT AS application_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT si.scheduled_interview_id)::BIGINT AS total_interviews,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE si.status = 'completed')::BIGINT AS completed_interviews,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sc.scorecard_id)::BIGINT AS total_scorecards,
        AVG(CASE sc.overall_recommendation WHEN 'strong_yes' THEN 4 WHEN 'yes' THEN 3 WHEN 'no' THEN 2 WHEN 'definitely_not' THEN 1 END) AS avg_interview_score
    FROM staging.stg_greenhouse__job_application AS ja
    INNER JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__application AS a ON ja.application_id = a.application_id
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__scheduled_interview AS si ON a.application_id = si.application_id
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__scorecard AS sc ON a.application_id = sc.application_id
    WHERE a.applied_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ja.job_id, application_year, application_quarter
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ja.*, COALESCE(im.total_interviews, 0)::BIGINT AS total_interviews,
        COALESCE(im.completed_interviews, 0)::BIGINT AS completed_interviews,
        COALESCE(im.total_scorecards, 0)::BIGINT AS total_scorecards,
        im.avg_interview_score,
        ja.hired_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(ja.total_applications, 0) AS hire_rate,
        COALESCE(im.total_interviews, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(ja.total_applications, 0) AS interview_rate,
        ja.hired_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(im.total_interviews, 0) AS interview_to_hire_rate,
        COALESCE(im.completed_interviews, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(im.total_interviews, 0) AS interview_completion_rate
    FROM job_applications AS ja
    LEFT JOIN interview_metrics AS im USING (job_id, application_year, application_quarter)
)
SELECT job_id, job_title, job_status, job_created_at, application_year, application_quarter,
    total_applications, unique_candidates, hired_count, active_count, rejected_count, avg_process_days,
    total_interviews, completed_interviews, total_scorecards, avg_interview_score,
    COALESCE(hire_rate, 0.0) AS hire_rate, COALESCE(interview_rate, 0.0) AS interview_rate,
    COALESCE(interview_to_hire_rate, 0.0) AS interview_to_hire_rate,
    COALESCE(interview_completion_rate, 0.0) AS interview_completion_rate,
    CASE WHEN hired_count >= 3 AND hire_rate >= 20 THEN 'Excellent'
         WHEN hired_count >= 2 AND hire_rate >= 15 THEN 'Good'
         WHEN hired_count >= 1 AND hire_rate >= 10 THEN 'Average'
         WHEN total_applications >= 10 THEN 'Needs Improvement' ELSE 'Low Activity' END AS performance_tier,
    CASE WHEN avg_process_days <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fast_process,
    CASE WHEN avg_interview_score >= 3.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_good_interview_quality
FROM combined
WHERE total_applications >= 1
ORDER BY application_year DESC, application_quarter DESC, hire_rate DESC

WITH application_base AS (
    SELECT a.application_id, a.candidate_id, a.status, a.applied_at, a.rejected_at, a.last_activity_at,
        a.source_id, s.name AS source_name, s.source_type_name AS source_type,
        YEAR(a.applied_at)::BIGINT AS application_year, QUARTER(a.applied_at)::BIGINT AS application_quarter,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staging.stg_greenhouse__scheduled_interview AS si WHERE si.application_id = a.application_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_interview
    FROM staging.stg_greenhouse__application AS a
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_greenhouse__source AS s ON a.source_id = s.source_id
    WHERE a.applied_at IS NOT NULL AND a.source_id IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT source_id, source_name, source_type, application_year, application_quarter,
        COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS total_applications,
        COUNT(DISTINCT candidate_id)::BIGINT AS unique_candidates,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'hired')::BIGINT AS total_hires,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'active')::BIGINT AS active_applications,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rejected_at IS NOT NULL)::BIGINT AS rejected_applications,
        SUM(has_interview)::BIGINT AS applications_with_interviews,
        AVG(DATE_DIFF('microsecond', applied_at, COALESCE(rejected_at, last_activity_at)) / 86400000000.0) AS avg_process_days
    FROM application_base
    GROUP BY source_id, source_name, source_type, application_year, application_quarter
),
rates AS (
    SELECT *,
        total_hires * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_applications, 0) AS hire_rate,
        applications_with_interviews * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_applications, 0) AS interview_rate,
        total_hires * 100.0 / NULLIF(applications_with_interviews, 0) AS interview_to_hire_rate,
        rejected_applications * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_applications, 0) AS rejection_rate,
        total_hires * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_applications, 0) + total_applications / 10.0 AS efficiency_score
    FROM aggregated
)
SELECT source_id, source_name, source_type, application_year, application_quarter,
    total_applications, unique_candidates, total_hires, active_applications, rejected_applications,
    applications_with_interviews, avg_process_days,
    COALESCE(hire_rate, 0.0) AS hire_rate,
    COALESCE(interview_rate, 0.0) AS interview_rate,
    COALESCE(interview_to_hire_rate, 0.0) AS interview_to_hire_rate,
    COALESCE(rejection_rate, 0.0) AS rejection_rate,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY application_year, application_quarter ORDER BY hire_rate DESC) AS hire_rate_rank,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY application_year, application_quarter ORDER BY total_applications DESC) AS volume_rank,
    CASE WHEN hire_rate >= 20 AND total_applications >= 10 THEN 'High Performer'
